title: Legacy hand-managed layout migration, dry-run first, on a copy, refusing one-directional overwrite
question: Implementation target: rehearse converting the pre-plugin hand-managed layout -- loose skills in the live tree, hand-edited hook registrations, rule files modified in place -- into the plugin-managed layout. Work on a copy of a captured real layout, run the conversion in dry-run mode first and require the printed plan to match the applied result exactly, and demonstrate reversibility by restoring from the backup the conversion takes. Where the source holds content the target does not, the conversion must preserve it or refuse.

profile.isolation_assertion: assert_copy refuses Path.home()/.claude and the frozen fixtures/captured original. The conversion ran only under copy_path=/tmp/rel0017-emit-ucut5n5f. Host live profiles were not read or written.

drill.resume_policy: resumable with mandatory restore: a dirty resume marker rolls the plugin copy back to the conversion backup before the next attempt
steps: Copy fixtures/captured/{hand,plugin} into a tempfile worktree.
Print the dry-run mutation plan (create/overwrite/skip/refuse) without writing.
Snapshot the plugin copy as the conversion backup.
Apply the plan; measure the tree delta independently; require empty diff vs the plan writes.
Restore from that backup and require the raw sha256 hash set to match pre-apply.

dry_run_plan.reason: one-directional overwrite refused: unique content on the other side (classification=BOTH-UNIQUE, policy=default)
add preserved source-unique listings; keep plugin-only paths

source_unique_preserved_versus_refused.note: preserved = SOURCE-ONLY files copied into the plugin layout with raw sha256 intact; refused = both-unique (or target-superset) paths that would destroy unique bytes on a one-directional copy

restore.algorithm: sha256 of raw bytes (CRLF preserved; not LF-normalised)

divergence_honesty.catalog_pin_5_of_88: WORK-UNIT-CATALOG cites a 2026-08-09 estate measurement of 5 of 88 live rule files identical to repository counterparts. That number is a historical pin, not today's host measurement.
invariants: an inverse may never remove a path the installer did not create
an inverse may never remove a command, skill or setting that pre-dated the install

create_file.invariant: after inverse, the path is absent AND the path is in the installer_created_set recorded at apply time

overwrite_file.invariant: after inverse, bytes equal the conversion backup snapshot

backup_tree.invariant: backup directory remains readable until restore completes

delete_file.invariant: delete is only legal for installer_created_set members

inverse_control.invariant: an inverse may never remove a path the installer did not create
inverse_control.error: an inverse may never remove a path the installer did not create: rules/rule.plugin-only.md not in created_set
